chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about selling yarn in exchange for woven clothes, while the yarn is greater in weight than the clothes. He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell yarn for woven clothes when the yarn weighs more than the clothes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a transaction involving yarn exchanged for woven garments when the yarn is heavier than the garments. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that there is no problem with such a sale, indicating its permissibility in this form.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3807 - Abdul-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah narrated:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about selling yarn in exchange for woven clothes, where the yarn weighs more than the clothes.
The Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
